title: UN Commission finding on four genocidal acts in Gaza
summary: The Commission published a Genocide Convention legal analysis of Israeli authorities' and security forces' conduct in Gaza since October 2023.
claim: The Commission concluded on reasonable grounds that Israeli authorities and security forces committed and continued to commit four genocidal acts: killing, serious bodily or mental harm, destructive conditions of life and measures intended to prevent births.
legal_characterization: Genocide-related legal finding by a UN commission of inquiry under its reasonable-grounds standard; not an ICJ judgment or final judicial determination of state responsibility.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Legal analysis of the conduct of Israel in Gaza pursuant to the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 252 of A/HRC/60/CRP.3. UN_FINDING is deliberate: this is the Commission's conclusion under its reasonable-grounds standard, not a final merits judgment by the International Court of Justice and not an independent conclusion by this ledger.
